```python
weights = []
values = []

def knapsack_recur(capacity: int, counter: int) -> int:
    # Base Case
    if counter == 0 or capacity == 0:
        return 0

    idx = counter - 1
    # Skip the item if it doesn't fit
    if weights[idx] > capacity:
        return knapsack_recur(capacity, counter - 1)

    # Choose the better of including or excluding the current item
    include = values[idx] + knapsack_recur(capacity - weights[idx], counter - 1)
    exclude = knapsack_recur(capacity, counter - 1)
    return max(include, exclude)
```
